business_problem: People's Daily needed to modernize news production for a large-scale mobile and multimedia audience while preserving editorial quality and safety. The organization had to handle huge volumes of video, image, and text assets, accelerate cloud-based editing, search, and review, and support AI-assisted content production across the full newsroom workflow.
solution_summary: People's Daily combined full cloud migration with an AI editorial platform from Alibaba Cloud. The client application moved onto Alibaba Cloud infrastructure using elastic architecture, CDN, video cloud, and managed operations so the media platform could scale for a large mobile audience. On top of that base, the Video Cloud AI Editorial Department became the newsroom automation layer. It processes video, image, and text assets for tasks such as cloud-based non-linear editing, intelligent poster generation, one-click portrait extraction, multimodal search, and intelligent review. Multimodal search combines face recognition, object recognition, speech recognition, OCR, video DNA, and natural-language processing so editors can find the right material quickly. Intelligent review uses AI plus big-data rules to flag content elements and scenarios before publication. Together, these systems give People's Daily an AI-assisted production line for faster multimedia journalism at newsroom scale.

solution_components.name: Elastic Compute Service (ECS)
solution_components.role: Provides elastic cloud compute for the client platform and AI-powered editorial workloads.

solution_components.name: Object Storage Service (OSS)
solution_components.role: Stores media assets and supports large-scale cloud editing and processing workflows.

solution_components.name: Elasticsearch
solution_components.role: Supports fast retrieval across large multimedia and text collections in newsroom search scenarios.

solution_components.name: OCR
solution_components.role: Extracts text from media assets as part of the multimodal search and review pipeline.

data_flow: Video, image, and text assets are uploaded into the cloud editorial environment, where AI editorial tools process them for editing, auto-generation, search, and review. Editors query the asset pool through multimodal retrieval, retrieve the needed materials, and publish optimized content back to the mobile client and broader media channels.
business_outcome: People's Daily built an AI-assisted newsroom that can produce and review multimedia stories much faster than a purely local workflow. The system supports a client with more than 110 million downloads, can elastically create hundreds of cloud editing workstations during peak reporting periods, and gives editors faster search, automated asset generation, and safer content review for major reporting events.

architecture_clues: AI editorial automation sits on top of a broader client-cloud migration rather than operating as a disconnected experiment.
Multimodal retrieval combines face, object, speech, OCR, video-DNA, and NLP signals in one search workflow.
Cloud non-linear editing allows reporters to connect to high-performance editing resources remotely instead of relying only on local workstations.
Intelligent review mixes AI and big-data rules to support publication safety checks before release.

The AI Editorial Department uses big data and AI to process massive video, image, and text assets and automatically generate video and graphic stories for specific themes. (original: 整个系统借助大数据和人工智能技术，对海量视频、图片、文字进行符合新闻业务标准的高效处理，针对设定好的主题，实现视频稿件、图文稿件的自动化、批量化、智能化生产。)

The upgraded system adds “look, understand, and review” capabilities, including intelligent poster generation, one-click portrait extraction, multimodal search, and content review. (original: 升级后的“人民日报 AI 智能编辑部”新增了多项功能，重点提升了“看”“悟”“审”能力。)

Multimodal search uses face recognition, object recognition, speech recognition, NLP, OCR, and video-DNA algorithms so editors can find assets more accurately and quickly. (original: 多模搜索功能借助人脸识别、物体识别、语音识别、自然语言处理、OCR 识别，及视频 DNA 的底层算法能力。)
